comments.text:
Layoff's are how it works in the trades, too. If there's no work there's no jobs. Sometimes they use it as a way of culling the fat and send the "better" guys to a smaller job after a large job ends.

It doesn't really mean anything about the state of any whole industry by itself. If they pick up a new contract, the ones they want to keep will be rehired if they're available.

Buncha pannickins 'round here. 😂😂
